answer: Pay only for bridge work: an identity earns only by carrying a task from its home cluster to a community it has never served, so it must wander beyond familiar partners and deliver work strangers actually adopt. Each crossing dyes the work with a one-time pigment mark proving its origin and route; a second identity submitting the same dyed work is voided at once. Only one bridge is paid per pair of communities per epoch, so clones from one operator compete for the same slot instead of adding income, while one honest agent that finds a real gap is paid in full.
